comment: Single place for Academy SKU coverage, launch prices, and academy_courses.product_codes. R2 is final: product_codes is a text[] allow-list. product_code is the primary catalog SKU and must appear in product_codes.

r2.note: Importer writes product_codes per catalog course as: catalogSku (solo_bundle), plus courseOwnCodes[slug] when set, plus every products[].product_code whose covers list includes that course (team_5 and team_10 today). Flip a course's own code here when a per-course SKU exists.

products.title: Solo Bundle
products.summary: Every self-paced Academy course on Elsa 3.9.0, one seat.
